about.title: A small studio with uncompromising attention to detail.
about.body: We started from one simple belief: the best design decisions happen when drawings, costs, and materials sit on the same table. That is why Geost designers, estimators, and site supervisors work as one team — one process, one owner.
about.bodySecondary: Every project starts by reading how you actually use a room, not by chasing trends. The result is a space that feels right from the first day you live in it.
points: Design and construction under one roof
Local materials with premium finishing standards

testimonials.title: What changed once the space was finished.

items.quote: Geost reworked our office ground floor without stopping operations. The 360° render was the clincher — the board approved it in a single session.
items.name: Rani Kusuma

items.quote: I expected endless revisions. Instead the cost estimate and the working drawings matched, so there were no surprises during construction.
items.name: Dimas Hartono

items.quote: The timber detailing and lighting are immaculate. The house feels larger than the floor plan I had imagined.
items.name: Sinta Maharani

items.q: Can I see the design before construction starts?
items.a: Yes. You receive 3D renders, a layout plan, and — on Project packages and above — a 360° model you can orbit right in the browser.

items.q: How long does it take from design to handover?
items.a: A single room usually takes 3–5 weeks of design, followed by 6–10 weeks of construction depending on scope and material availability.
Yes. We build interiors with our own crew and regular subcontractors, so design intent and execution stay with one accountable team.

items.q: How does the AI preview work?
items.a: You upload a photo of the room and describe what you want. The system generates a concept image as an early discussion reference — not a final construction result.
Yes. For Jakarta, Bali, and Surabaya projects we schedule periodic site visits. Travel costs are quoted separately.
